description: Add an order for a customer: pass customer_id, and optionally agent_id, billing_contact_id (a contact of that customer), status (default draft), total_amount (default 0), currency (default USD) and metadata. Needs a claimed Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

agent_id.description: The agent the order is for.

billing_contact_id.description: The contact: its id, as list_contacts shows it.

currency.description: The currency code. Defaults to USD.

customer_id.description: The customer: its id, as list_customers shows it.

metadata.description: Anything worth keeping with the record.

name: create_order
